rows.en: Mari! Why are you running away?
Please… don't follow me any further.
Why? Do you think I'm some kind of stalker?
No… I'm simply not someone who can return your love.

Don't be ridiculous!

Whatever old-fashioned ideas you bring up, I still…

I love you!

Taki… Can you still love me, even like this?

Change, Bijinder!
You're…!?
Goodbye! Taaah!

…!?

Mari!

Bijindeeer!
Nuoooh… That I, of all people, should…!
Ngh, damn it…!?
Ngh… He's… good…!
Defeat all Shadowmen!
Defeat Waruder…!
Defeat Waruder (Shadow) and Bijinder (Shadow)!
Defeat the Giant Devil, Shadow Knight, Bijinder (Shadow) and all Shadowmen!
Defeat the Giant Devil, Waruder, Waruder (Shadow), Bijinder (Shadow), all Shadowmen and the Gigants!
Mari is defeated
Waruder is defeated

Mister Brain!

Now that Gomez is dead… surely you can leave all operations to me…!
I'm afraid not, Hustler… You remain robot commander, as before.
Mister Brain! Are you really going to leave the Brain Party's operations to this whippersnapper?
Field command of the Brain Party will be taken by Apfaron of the Naager.
Mister Brain, you have my thanks.
By the way, Hustler… Have you grasped the outline of Project B?

I'll report…

With Doctor Sahara at the center, they intend to build a new computer, never learning their lesson.
Foolish humans…
Oh yes, Mister Brain! How's that thing of ours coming along?
Its completion is near…
Hahaha… I'd love to see the finished product as soon as possible!
Well, everyone… We've arrived at our destination!
So this is the Susono Campground?
Sorry about this… dragging you all along for my sake.
Not at all! This is summer camp, after all, so we have to make lots of fun memories…

[HERO4], just so you know, you're not the one making memories here.

We're here as Saburo's bodyguards.
Huh…? But Mr. Tachibana said that at summer camp, playing is learning…
That's Mr. Tachibana for you… He says the nicest things!
[HERO4]… You took this job planning to play from the start, didn't you?
Well then, Ms. Kitakura… good luck with your mission!

Heh heh… It'll be fine!

Mission or not, all I have to do is escort a liaison officer from overseas…

If I finish early, maybe I'll join you, Saburo, and the others.
Now even you're saying that, Ms. Kitakura…
It's nothing to be sorry about. This is summer camp, after all, so we have to make lots of fun memories…

[HERO4], let me make sure we're clear: you're not the one making memories here.

We're Saburo's bodyguards! We can't go joining in on all the fun, okay?
Yeah… I know! But a little bit is fine, right?
Come on, you two! The campground's over there, over there!

Yazaki…

No spacing out! Take this firewood over to Saburo! I'll go gather some more…
Hey, Yazaki! Hurry up, the fire's going out.
If you're in such a hurry, come get it yourself!
Yazaki…
The blueprints for this part arrive today from the Caribbean Branch…

And with that… Project B will be complete, right?

The Caribbean Branch reported that it left on schedule.
Mm… Chief Kitakura should be arriving at the site about now, shouldn't she?
Saburo and the others must be having fun at the campground right about now.
Yes… Rumi must be enjoying herself too.

…!?

Unidentified object, 60 kilometers north-northwest!

What!? An unidentified object?

That direction… is close to Chief Kitakura's route. Contact her, just to be safe.

Yes, sir…

Chief Kitakura… Chief Kitakura, please respond!
Yes, Security Squad here…
Chief Kitakura! We've detected an unidentified object ahead of the Security Squad.

An unidentified object!?

The fog is so thick I can't see a thing.
Be careful, it's approaching you!

…!?

Something's coming closer! What on earth is that sound!?
Can you see anything!?
I can't see anything… Only huge footsteps…?
Footsteps…?
One-Seven…!?
Chief Kitakura, what happened!? What's going on?
There's no answer…
Something's happened to the Security Squad!
Send help at once…
I wonder what's up with Yazaki? He's acting a little weird.
A week ago… his mother went out shopping and never came back, they say…
She's missing?

I see… Yazaki lived alone with his mom, didn't he?

And now his mom's missing… I know exactly how Yazaki feels.

Shut up, you idiot! Spare me your lousy sympathy!

Pitying me won't bring my mom back…
Mom, you idiot! Where did you go, leaving me all alone!?

…!?

Waaaaah…!?

…!?

Time to show what a bodyguard can do!
Everyone, get inside the tents! Come on, hurry…

uncertain: U10104: "Change, Bijinder!" kept as the show's transformation call.
U10108-U10110: defeat reactions; U10110 Ichiro's "でき…る…" read as acknowledging an opponent's skill ("He's… good…"); opponent assumed to be Waruder.
U10116: source has "…?" after the defeat condition; dropped to keep the standard form.
U10120/U10251: 舌造 read as 若造 "whippersnapper".
U10123: B計両 read as B計画 "Project B".
U10132/U10140: 林間学校 rendered "summer camp" (school outing camp).
U10140: [HERO4]'s "悪いことなんてないよ" answers Saburo's "なんだか悪いな" (U10131) in the other route; "It's nothing to be sorry about".
U10171: Rumi tells the bodyguards about Yazaki's mother; "they say" for んですって.
U10174-U10176: Yazaki's speech continues over two narration-kind rows; kept split.

new_names.why: from glossary entry Brain Party Pilot
how Hustler addresses Brain, not in glossary
